name: Baba Keizou
source:
Kaede's uncle and Anoyama's landowner. His wife passed away and he has been living alone for over a decade.

For generations the Baba family tree has had pure-blooded Anoyama natives tying the knot, and Keizou too is insistent on having descendants with Anoyama blood in their veins.

[Translated from [url=http://venus66.sakura.ne.jp/baba.html]the official site[/url]]
